name: endbuy
description: endBuy — application de communication (texte, voix, vidéo) avec endBuy Nitro Lifetime offert à tous.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server test
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
